board_dark.note: the board's dark square, the other half of the boss floor

board_light.note: the board's pale square — inside here, chess rules bind

box_ruins.note: the spilled chess box, torn cardboard walls to fight between

chalk_path.note: a child's chalk line — the map's only signage, points onward

crayon_ramp.note: a spill of crayons laid like logs — the climb out of the floor

crossbar.note: the table's crossbar — high road, drops away on both sides

deep_pile.note: thick carpet; where the pawn wakes up, slow and ash-dark

deep_pile_worn.note: carpet trodden flat — the readable path through the pile

gate.note: the seam the Knight defends; crossing it starts the fight

lamplight.note: the pool of lamplight the kingdom sits in; safety you can see

ruler_bridge.note: the Ruler: one plank wide, no cover, the crossing you dread

sag.note: the sagging fabric bowl; every step funnels toward the middle

tablecloth.note: hanging cloth — the wall that closes the world's west side

varnish.note: polished floorboard; the open middle where sightlines are long

void.note: the dark under the table; the edge of everything
